from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """A court document with its title and case cause."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this court document as named in the document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause/type (案由) as stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    court_documents: list[CourtDocument]
